meta_description:
27K likes, 150 comments - hauterrfly on October 21, 2026: "Welcome to Season 2 of Sleepover With Anushka Sen powered by Samsung Galaxy!

Kicking off Season 2, Indian pop girl group W.i.S.H. joins Anushka Sen for a fun-filled girls’ sleepover packed with music, food, games and unfiltered conversations.

From an impromptu concert and Anushka becoming the group’s fifth member to sharing favourite foods, school tiffin memories and their dream of visiting Korea, the girls let loose and get to know each other beyond the music. They also get candid about Gen Z dating, situationships, finding love in real life, relationship red flags and the qualities they look for in a partner.

The sleepover gets even more entertaining with hilarious games, a game of Twister, and a round of Spin the Bottle that brings out the girls’ playful and unpredictable sides. With plenty of laughter, friendly banter and honest girl talk, this is W.i.S.H. like you’ve never seen them before!

The girls capture their favourite moments, explore Photo Assist to transform pictures into anime-style memories, and bring their dream of visiting Korea to life through a creative vision board.

Filmed #withGalaxy S26 Ultra

Watch the first episode of Season 2 as Anushka Sen and W.i.S.H. bond over music, love, friendship and everything in between, only on Hauterrfly.

#WiSH #AnushkaSen #SleepoverWithAnushka #Samsung".
